title: papaver rhoeas f. bipinnatum
intro: Papaver rhoeas f. bipinnatum, commonly known as the Shirley poppy, is a rare and lesser-known variety of the common poppy plant. The plant is known for its delicate, frilly petals and is often used as an ornamental in gardens. The health benefits of Papaver rhoeas f. bipinnatum include its potential anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in the treatment of various health conditions such as wounds and infections. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are thought to possess therapeutic actions such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
